posts.text: before hopping on the ‘encoder-free’ hype train, think twice.
posts.quoted: how should multimodal models encode visual input? → pretrained encoder? → encoder-free? → before the LLM? published models bundle these choices together. we trained 200+ models from scratch to see which of these choices matters only one of them does [1/n]
